claude_proposed_widenings.name: advantage_on_check (OngoingOperation variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Hunter's Mark grants Advantage on Wisdom (Perception or Survival) checks to find the marked creature. No OngoingOperation variant exists for skill-check advantage; only roll_modifier (numeric delta) and damage_on_hit are modeled.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You also have Advantage on any Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check you make to find it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: operations array in OngoingEffectMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Hunter's Mark has two simultaneous ongoing effects: damage_on_hit and advantage_on_check. The current surface has a singular operation field (OngoingOperation), not ReadonlyArray<OngoingOperation>. Without an array, both effects cannot be expressed together honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...deal an extra 1d6 Force damage... You also have Advantage on any Wisdom check...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: slot-scaling Duration for concentration upcast
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Hunter's Mark changes its concentration ceiling based on slot level: base 1 hour (slots 1-2), up to 8 hours (slots 3-4), up to 24 hours (slot 5+). The Duration type has no slot-scaling variant; concentration is always a fixed DurationValue.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 3-4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).
